mintAuthority.summary: IAUon has issuer-controlled native issuance on Ethereum, BSC, and Solana. Ethereum and BSC native GMTokenManager paths are administered by two-hour beacon-owner timelocks; Solana issuance is controlled by the Ondo GM program PDA whose upgrade authority is a bare system account with unverifiable off-chain custody. Ethereum and BSC OndoOFT overlays, the HyperEVM representation, LayerZero validation, route administration, rate limiting, and representation upgrades are assessed separately in bridgeRouteRisk rather than as native Mint Authority.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (Ethereum) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) = 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c; Blockscout source: GMTokenManager. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets.

controls.label: IAUon Ethereum/BSC beacon-owner timelocks
controls.evidence: At the current review, Ethereum and BSC IAUon tokens resolve through UpgradeableBeacon contracts 0x985462c9aa4d6c3ad59ae6e1e9c0c11347ed1598 and 0xc046b05a920e4b412815934dd8e58904dda73315. Their owners are distinct TimelockControllers with 7,200-second delays; the BSC timelock proposes through the 4-of-7 Safe 0xa307e57ca7f9712af3557af8c5624bef214aa913, executes/cancels through the 1-of-9 Safe 0x80120c4d44ffd6f86716fd8dacd5e395d8bbbe97 plus EOA 0xff1621ee754512b34a6bd62a941cc4d5e4d0b85b, and is administered by the 5-of-9 Safe 0xa3a3c71380128972f172ff4052af7b6405da6364. HyperEVM representation upgradeability is assessed separately in bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: GMTokenManager (BSC) — primary minter
controls.evidence: At BSC block 112486221, getRoleMember(MINTER_ROLE, 0) on the BSC IAUon token returned this contract; its sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member is the BSC 2-hour timelock 0x8860bbfc7a83e4788a981f4e9f30878331413b26. This contract handles issuer subscription/redemption minting for Ondo Global Markets on BSC.

controls.label: Ondo GM Solana program mint authority PDA
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 435577237, the IAUon Token-2022 mint M77ZvkZ8zW5udRbuJCbuwSwavRa7bGAZYMTwru8ondo reports mint authority 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD, a program-derived address with no keypair (no SOL account). Recent mint transactions invoke the Ondo GM Solana program XzTT4XB8m7sLD2xi6snefSasaswsKCxx5Tifjondogm, which signs through this PDA; the mint's freeze authority is Ondo's 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK (a bare system account).

controls.label: Ondo GM Solana program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 435577237, the Ondo GM program XzTT4XB8m7sLD2xi6snefSasaswsKCxx5Tifjondogm is a BPFUpgradeableLoader program whose program-data account F4F1ZdqwmT4KfCfCnXrqLp9R6Liq4vEqJcs64xVKTKeU records upgrade authority 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM (program last deployed at slot 429073863). That authority is a bare system account (~13.19 SOL, no program), i.e. a single-key-class authority whose off-chain custody (single key, HSM, or MPC) is not verifiable on-chain. It can replace the program that controls the mint-authority PDA.

review.evidence: Current review evidence separates native issuance from bridge representations. Ethereum block 25770668 and BSC block 116353763 show GMTokenManager as a native IAUon minter alongside the separate OndoOFT bridge overlay; the native token beacon owners are two-hour timelocks. At finalized Solana slot 439728907, Token-2022 mint M77ZvkZ8zW5udRbuJCbuwSwavRa7bGAZYMTwru8ondo is controlled by the Ondo GM program PDA 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD, and at slot 439729018 its program data reports upgrade authority 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM; that bare system account has no on-chain custody or quorum proof. HyperEVM is a LayerZero bridge representation and its beacon upgrade path is recorded in bridgeRouteRisk. The corrected native control set therefore retains unbounded, periodically reconciled, attestation-only economics and probable confidence.
